storage - all chests as one storage (shroudlink mod)
=====================================================
MODS > Storage shows everything in the chests within 40 m of you as one grid, largest
stacks first, with a search. Click an item to take all of it from every chest into your
backpack (as much as fits).

REQUIRES the shroudlink core (shroudlink-core.zip) and the player addon
(shroudlink-client.zip).

INSTALL: unpack this zip into the server folder (where enshrouded_server.exe is), so that
storage.dll lands in shroudlink_mods. To switch it off, remove storage.dll.
